name: Bursts
description: 80 MHz around the knob's frequency in channels, with a chooser where both sources work. Gapless (the WHY2025 badge's C6 keeps the 10 us windows that stand out): channelized on the P4 into 40 channels of 2 MHz with a burst detector per channel, each channel's power over its floor, occupancy over time, and the bursts that ended with their frequency, length and level. Snapshots (205 us whenever a burst rises past the threshold; the MCH2022 badge's ESP32 checks a burst every few milliseconds): 64 channels of 1.25 MHz, channel power, occupancy over time, and the newest burst in time and frequency.
author: esp-sdr
